```plato

    // The area-weighted vertex normal of every vertex: the normalized sum of the
    // vector areas of the incident triangles, which weights each face by its own
    // area without a separate weight term.
    VertexNormalVectors(self: TriangleMesh3D): Array<Vector3D>
        => self.Positions.Count.MapRange(v => NormalizedOrZero(
            self.Faces.Count.MapRange(f => f).Reduce(Vector3D(0.0, 0.0, 0.0), (acc, f) =>
                self.Faces[f].HasVertex(VertexIndex(v))
                    ? acc + self.Triangle(FaceIndex(f)).TwiceVectorArea
                    : acc)));
```
